title: The Shepherd Boy Chosen
paragraphs: The prophet Samuel was sent to Bethlehem to choose a new king. Jesse paraded seven fine, tall sons. None was the one. "Are all your children here?" Samuel asked. "There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep." They sent for David. God said, "Arise! Anoint him, for this is he." God doesn't choose by height or looks; God looks at the heart. Later God made David a great promise: one of his family would reign for ever. Bethlehem again, sheep again. Hold on to those two words. They will come back on Christmas night.
wonder: I wonder why God picks the one nobody expected?
prayer: God who sees the heart, help us to value the people others overlook, including ourselves. Amen.
alt: A shepherd boy with a staff and sheep on a hill, with a golden crown-shaped thread rising above.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
